posts.author: rajpanda
posts.community: Afcom Holdings - Sky High Ambitions, Grounded in Reality?
posts.text: Typically it refers to “consumables and spares, rotables” required for aircraft maintenance and such things. We don’t see this line item in FY25 AR because then it was opearing the airfcrafts in wet lease model, in which, maintenance and consumable is duty of lessor and where as in dry lease it’s the duty of lessee. There has been an improvement in operating margin QoQ, even though there is a fall of 7% in topline over same period.
